query_ground_truth.query: list messages in Discord for operational coordination
query_ground_truth.rationale: Coordinating operational tasks via Discord requires listing and reading channel messages.

request.query: list messages in Discord for operational coordination

results.use_case: list messages in Discord for operational coordination
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if server identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover accessible servers using DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS (pick target server identifier for downstream bot reads).
[Optional (if bot auth/connection is uncertain or prior reads failed)] [Prerequisite]: Validate bot credentials using DISCORDBOT_TEST_AUTH (continue only when auth_ok=true).
[Required] [Step]: List channels in the target server using DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS (collect message-capable channel identifiers to scan).

[Required] [Step]: For each channel, fetch history using DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES (paginate with before/after; filter to a consistent UTC cutoff for a recent lookback window; stop paging a channel once pages are older than the cutoff).
[Optional (if readable labeling/validation is needed)] [Next Step]: Fetch channel metadata using DISCORDBOT_GET_CHANNEL (map identifiers to type/label for reporting only on included channels).

[Optional (if expected messages are missing and threads are used)] [Fallback]: Enumerate threads using DISCORDBOT_LIST_PUBLIC_ARCHIVED_THREADS, then fetch thread messages using DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES (apply the same cutoff and pagination rules).
known_pitfalls: [DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS] Response shape can vary by wrapper; the server array may appear under data.guilds or data.details—confirm before extracting identifiers.
[DISCORDBOT_TEST_AUTH] Can return auth_ok=false with status_code=401; treat as a hard blocker before DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS or DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES.
[DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES] Page size is capped at ~100 messages per call; active channels require multi-page pagination to cover the target window.
[DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES] Inaccessible/invalid channels can fail with HTTP 404 ("Unknown Channel" / error code 10003); re-sync identifiers via DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS.
[COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH] Direct REST-style workarounds for listing/reading can still yield 401/404 in some contexts; prefer DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS and DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES.

DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS.description: Fetches all channels (text, voice, category, etc.) for a specified Discord guild. Does not include threads or message content.

guild_id.description: Identifier of the Discord guild (server) whose channels to list.

DISCORDBOT_LIST_MESSAGES.description: Retrieves messages from a Discord channel, ordered newest first. Supports pagination via before/after/around parameters.

after.description: Get messages after this message ID for forward pagination.

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (1-100, defaults to 50).

around.description: Get messages around this message ID.

before.description: Get messages before this message ID for backward pagination.

channel_id.description: ID of the Discord channel to fetch messages from.

DISCORDBOT_GET_CHANNEL.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific Discord channel by its channel_id. Returns only channel metadata, not message content or member lists.

channel_id.description: The ID of the Discord channel to retrieve.
